name: Blox Fruits
tagline: Latest working Blox Fruits codes for free 2x XP boosts, Beli and stat resets.
description: Blox Fruits is a Roblox One Piece-inspired adventure where players sail the seas, master Devil Fruits and fight bosses. New codes drop with each update and influencer milestone, granting free 2x XP boosts, in-game Beli and stat resets. Every code on this page has been verified against major aggregators (Pocket Tactics, Pro Game Guides, the Blox Fruits Fandom wiki) and is refreshed as new codes are added or old ones expire.

redeemSteps.title: Launch Blox Fruits
redeemSteps.detail: Open Roblox and start a Blox Fruits session. You can be on any island or in any sea — codes can be redeemed anywhere.

redeemSteps.title: Click the Twitter / X icon on the left
redeemSteps.detail: Look for the small blue bird icon on the left side of your screen. Tapping it opens the in-game code redemption text box directly — no need to open a menu first.

redeemSteps.title: Paste the code exactly
redeemSteps.detail: Copy a code from this page and paste it character-for-character. Codes are case-sensitive — 'KITT_RESET' and 'kitt_reset' are not the same.

redeemSteps.title: Hit Try
redeemSteps.detail: Press the Try button. A green 'Success' message confirms the reward has been applied. If you see a red error, the code is likely expired or mistyped.

faq.question: How often are new Blox Fruits codes released?
faq.answer: New codes usually drop alongside major updates, milestone events (likes / visits / billions), and developer or partnered-creator livestreams — roughly every 2–4 weeks.

faq.question: Why is my Blox Fruits code not working?
faq.answer: Codes are case-sensitive and expire fast. Make sure you copied the code exactly as listed (capitalisation matters). If it still fails, it has likely expired — cross-check against the Expired Codes page.

faq.question: Can I redeem a code twice?
faq.answer: No. Each Blox Fruits code can only be redeemed once per account.

faq.question: Do 2x XP boosts stack?
faq.answer: The multiplier does not stack (you stay at 2x, not 4x or 8x), but the durations do. Redeeming several XP codes back-to-back gives you a longer continuous 2x window instead of a higher multiplier.
